name: contabridge-mcp
description: Convierte el libro diario entre A3 (SUENLACE.DAT), ContaPlus, Sage 50 y CSV, y pasa extractos Norma 43 a asientos.
long_description: Puente contable para gestorías: convierte y valida ficheros de importación de asientos entre A3, ContaPlus/Sage 50 y CSV, genera asientos desde extractos Norma 43 con reglas y redimensiona subcuentas. Pago por uso con créditos KeyFlint.

tools.name: convert_journal
tools.description: Convert a libro diario (journal) between Spanish accounting programs.

tools.name: validate_journal
tools.description: Check a journal file the way A3/ContaPlus check it on import, before you send it.

tools.name: bank_to_journal
tools.description: Turn a Norma 43 (Cuaderno 43) bank statement into journal entries ready to import.

tools.name: build_journal
tools.description: Write journal entries you composed (e.g. from invoices or a payroll summary) as an import file.

tools.name: resize_account
tools.description: Resize or expand a Spanish subaccount code. Free. '430.1' -> '43000001'; 4300001 (7) -> 43000001 (8).

tools.name: detect_format
tools.description: Tell which accounting import format a file is (a3, contaplus_csv, contaplus_ascii, csv). Free.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Credit price of each tool and where to buy credits. Free.

tools.name: credits_balance
tools.description: Remaining credits on your KeyFlint license. Free.
